items.question: Into what locus does the radiance situated in the throat-cavity dissolve?
premises: A radiance is situated in the throat-cavity.
The brahma-aperture is a locus of absorption.
This radiance goes to absorption in that locus.
items.inference: The radiance situated in the throat-cavity attains dissolution in the brahma-aperture.
uncertainties: The feminine gender of 'gatā' suggests an implied feminine subject not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: The radiance situated in the cavity of the throat has gone to absorption in the brahma-aperture.
